name: AgentPass Preflight Agent
description: Checks a proposed agent action against identity, scope, cost, data-retention, and human-approval constraints.

skills.name: Agent action preflight
skills.description: Return safe_to_proceed, needs_review, or denied from declared action constraints before an autonomous action is executed.
examples: Check whether did:web:crew-07 may book a 428.20 USD flight under a 500 USD ceiling.
